structure.unit: Licenses for Waterfowl Blinds and for Hunting Waterfowl

law.catch_line: Stationary duck blind license; riparian landowners exempted
law.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of § 29.1-340, the owners of riparian rights or their invitees shall not be required to obtain a stationary blind license when hunting waterfowl from such a blind located on the riparian owner's property. However, a stationary blind license shall be required in order to afford the riparian owners the protections provided by §§ 29.1-344, 29.1-345, and 29.1-349.
